facing: +Z = aisle (pick) face; beams run along X

rig.tiling: for a run of N bays, clone the whole bay every 2.79 m along X and hide upright_frame_R on all but the last bay (frames are shared)
rig.levels: beam_level_* origins are at the beam top (pallet seat) height on the bay centre-line; translate Y to re-space levels

nodes.upright_frame_L/R: two uprights + Z-bracing + base plates + yellow column guards; origin at the frame centre on the ground
nodes.beam_level_N: front+back orange step beams with connectors and a galvanised wire deck; origin at the beam top
